subject.title: fix(openai): drop empty reasoning replay blocks

question: Should OpenClaw treat an empty signed OpenAI reasoning block as non-replayable unless its persisted signature contains content, encrypted_content, or summary state?
rationale: This intentionally changes persisted session replay across official and compatible Responses providers; source proof establishes transformation behavior, but maintainers must own the supported compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the narrow predicate
options.body: Merge after owner confirmation that content, encrypted_content, and summary are the complete replay-state fields OpenClaw supports.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Pause until a redacted live Responses request shows the id-only empty block is rejected and the sanitized replay succeeds.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers prefer preserving every signed reasoning item followed by content despite the provider-compatibility concern.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow predicate
recommendation.body: Merge after owner confirmation that content, encrypted_content, and summary are the complete replay-state fields OpenClaw supports.
